evidence_sources.claim_summary: PancakeSwap developer docs document PancakeV3Factory ABI and owner() mutability via setOwner without disclosing Safe 0x21835332 or 0s timelock authority.
Official pancake-v3-contracts Ethereum deployment manifest publishes PancakeV3Factory (0x0BFb...1865) while omitting controller Safe 0x21835332 and intermediary fee proxies.
Latest docs sync still lists only PancakeV3Factory 0x0BFb...1865 across v3 addresses without disclosing Ethereum governance authority, Safe quorum 3-of-7, or fee adapters.

gap_windows.summary: Public docs and deployments/eth.json never published controller Safe 0x21835332cBDf1b3530fAE9f6Cd66FEB9477dFC02, its 0s delay, or its 3-of-5 to 3-of-7 quorum dilution through 2026-11-19 UTC.

New PancakeV3Factory.owner() contract V3OpenFeeAdapter (0x0f6f9A6dd9f065DC4455bb2B8e3F0CFFB6F2410c) deployed and activated off-repo without docs or pancake-v3-contracts source publication through 2026-11-19 UTC.

executive_risk_memo: Across 2023-2026 on Ethereum Mainnet, PancakeSwap AMM V3's immutable PancakeV3Factory (0x0BFbCF9fa4f9C56B0F40a671Ad40E0805A091865, $631.86M protocol TVL) never placed factory owner() behind an on-chain TimelockController. Instead, deployer EOA 0x4049...1047 transferred ownership at block 16,953,677 (2023-04-01) directly to GnosisSafeProxy 0x21835332cBDf1b3530fAE9f6Cd66FEB9477dFC02, which later rotated factory ownership through unverified-in-repo ERC1967Proxy 0x0c0388E4...4879 (block 17,330,451) and, most recently, to V3OpenFeeAdapter 0x0f6f9A6dd9f065DC4455bb2B8e3F0CFFB6F2410c at block 26,254,650 (2026-10-23). Over the same window, controller Safe 0x21835332... expanded signers from 3-of-5 to 3-of-6 (block 17,685,263) and 3-of-7 (block 23,924,364) with zero guard contract and zero enabled modules through block 26,450,584, diluting signing threshold from 60% to 42.9% with 0-second execution. Documentation forensics establish an open 1,328-day disclosure gap through 2026-11-19 UTC across pancake-developer and deployments/eth.json, while trailing 12-month engineering telemetry on pancakeswap/pancake-v3-contracts shows near-maintenance activity (2 commits total by a single contributor, ChefSnoopy, bus_factor = 1) and off-repo activation of V3OpenFeeAdapter prior to public repo commits.
